sources.games: 1077 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 47.0%, hard support (STRATZ pos5, 9655 games). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py disruptor.
sources.items: No item rule: Ghost Scepter against break heroes (21% vs 11% of 84 games) was not bought more in won games and has no mechanic against them; build from the games.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 99% (4), magic_wand 74% (8), ring_of_basilius 94% (8), arcane_boots 93% (12), glimmer_cape 32% (23), blink 60% (23), staff_of_wizardry 56% (28), point_booster 45% (29), ogre_axe 44% (30), blade_of_alacrity 37% (33), ultimate_scepter 34% (34). Reviewed: Staff of Wizardry, Point Booster, Ogre Axe and Blade of Alacrity (parts of the Scepter) dropped; Blink Dagger put before Glimmer Cape: the league median minute is the same (23), Blink is bought in 60% of won games against 32%, and STRATZ pos5 has Blink 21 min 80%, Glimmer 22 min 35%, Aghanim's Scepter 34 min 65% (won 61%) (asked).

skills.basis: 1077 games since 7.41: maxed disruptor_glimpse > disruptor_thunder_strike > disruptor_kinetic_field 536 (win 55.8%), disruptor_glimpse > disruptor_kinetic_field > disruptor_thunder_strike 204 (win 54.9%), disruptor_glimpse > disruptor_thunder_strike 194 (win 29.4%); talents 10: +15 Thunder Strike Damage per Strike 779/1052 (47.1%), +20 Movement Speed 273/1052 (50.5%); 15: +60 Static Storm Max DPS 478/634 (57.1%), +15%/300 Glimpse Distance To Damage/Max 156/634 (64.1%); 20: +75 Static Storm Radius 144/166 (66.0%), +1s Kinetic Field Duration 22/166 (50.0%); 25: 2 Glimpse Charges 19/28 (63.2%), Thunder Strike Strikes 9/28 (88.9%).

notes.basis: Valve Static Storm (fetched 2026-11-07): silences all enemy units in 550 radius for 6 s (70-100 s cooldown, 800 cast range); the escape group is the escapes a silence stops (draft_analysis.ESCAPES). Glimpse: teleports the hero back to where it was 4 s ago (600-1800 range, 18-24 s cooldown).

reason.en: {enemy} runs away with spells: Static Storm silences everyone inside for 6 s so no escape spell works, and Glimpse pulls a runner back to where they stood 4 s ago
reason.uk: {enemy} тікає заклинаннями: Static Storm накладає тишу на всіх усередині на 6 с, тож заклинання втечі не спрацює, а Glimpse повертає втікача туди, де він стояв 4 с тому
